mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS owner_nickname FROM playlist p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist (user_id, title, description, total_duration, is_public, listen_minutes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{totalDuration}, #{isPublic}, #{listenMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist WHERE is_public = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist_layer (playlist_id, role, volume) VALUES (#{playlistId}, #{role}, #{volume})

INSERT INTO playlist_block (layer_id, block_id, sort_order, repeat_count, start_seconds) VALUES
(#{layerId}, #{item.blockId}, #{i} + 1, #{item.repeat}, #{item.startSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS layer_id, l.playlist_id, l.role, l.volume, pb.id AS pb_id, pb.block_id, pb.sort_order, pb.repeat_count, pb.start_seconds, b.title AS block_title, b.file_key, b.duration AS block_duration, b.price AS block_price, b.status AS block_status, b.is_active AS block_active, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.color AS cat_color, c.icon AS cat_icon, c.parent_id AS cat_parent_id, pc.name AS cat_parent_name FROM playlist_layer l JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id JOIN block b ON b.id = pb.block_id LEFT JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN sound_category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id WHERE l.playlist_id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.playlist_id, l.role, COALESCE(pb.start_seconds, 0), pb.sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE playlist SET play_count = play_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
